name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Iran fired on Kuwait, Bahrain 18 Nov
summary: Iran targeted a US base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain on 18 Nov after a US strike on Qeshm; the GCC blamed Iran
state: Kuwait said its air defences intercepted drone attacks early on 18 Nov, which Iran's military said targeted US Patriot systems at Ali Al Salem air base; Kuwait called it a flagrant violation of its sovereignty (The National). Bahrain said it intercepted aerial attacks from Iran, and the GCC secretary-general held Iran responsible for the escalation (Arab News). This followed a US strike on an IRGC missile site on Qeshm on 17 Nov (CNN). Active strikes between states keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Kuwait, Bahrain and the wider Gulf, which can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf shipping = Alert

sources.title: The National — Iran attacks Kuwait in widening escalation

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
